title: 第227章 问此间（五十五）
content_zh:
不光刘扶光与晏欢吃惊,来者亦从喉间“唬”了一声，像是诧异对方竟能抵挡过自己的一击。
借着明珠的光辉，刘扶光赫然看清,旱魃的身形极其瘦长，黑如钢铁的皮肤肌肉,尽数紧贴在坚不可摧的骨骼上，泛出诡异的古铜光泽，便如夜中的一道鬼影。至于样貌、衣袍，一概没有，骷髅嶙峋的头颅上，唯有两点炭火般的猩红双目,不住灼灼乱闪。
晏欢瞬时大怒,他的法衣与黑发猎猎飞舞、无风自动,身体还立在原地，头颈却突然探如长蛇，在半空中迅疾如电地抖开,一下绕至旱魃身后,面貌口唇,皆化出驼鼻獠牙的龙相。
他就这么张大了嘴,露出层层交错旋转的利齿,继而凶残地咬住了旱魃的半个胸膛。龙牙与旱魃如金如铜的肌肤悍然相撞,黑暗里，灼热的火星四溅喷发,旱魃骤然吃痛，不由发出狮吼般的咆哮。
一口居然还没咬穿,可见旱魃体质之强悍。晏欢长颈上,充当龙鬃的触须即刻伸长,蜂拥而至，在旱魃七窍之上游离。不仅刺进耳道、鼻腔，更有两只变幻尖锐棘刺，犹如鸟喙破壳，直接捅穿了两颗火目，去搅舐旱魃的脑仁。
旱魃造此酷刑，顷刻间失去了抵抗的能力，那凄厉的哀嚎，回荡在空旷黑暗的地底。
黑血顺着它扭曲的面目粘稠流淌，它嘶哑地大喊：“别杀我！你们要什么，我都给！”
晏欢一张嘴擒着不动，脖颈处游弋变幻，又生出另一张形状狭长，布满利齿的嘴巴，一张一合地阴冷笑道：“既如此，我们问什么，你便答什么了？”
平生第一次，旱魃心中生出了觳觫哆嗦的寒意。捕猎凡人上百年，它何曾见过这等超脱常理的可怖之物？此刻生死都拿捏在对方手里，它唯有忍着剧痛，不管不顾地大声道：“是的、是的！尊上请问！”
刘扶光心里知道，旱魃率先冲着自己来，身处干旱沙漠，它的行动简直如鱼得水，是以就连晏欢——或者说，就连神力巨幅削弱的晏欢，都未能及时发现它。
他这么想着，晏欢已然痛快地承诺道：“若你所言不虚，我便饶你一命。我且问你，你是天生的旱魃么？”
看见一线曙光，旱魃竹筒倒豆子地道：“我不知何为天生的旱魃！只是从一有神志开始，我便游荡在无边大地上，狩猎人族，以求饱腹。”
旱魃犹豫一下，捕捉到它的迟疑，触须狠狠一鞭，一下插在脑仁里乱搅，旱魃即刻尖声哀嚎，血泪横流。
得以缓和，旱魃气息奄奄，哀求道：“尊上明鉴，远不止……远不止我一头……”
“那便是了，”刘扶光道，“既然远不止你一头，凡人的生存条件如此险恶，纵使能够繁衍生息，也抵不过旱魃铜皮铁骨，力大无穷，他们应该早被你们吃尽了才是。这又作何解释呢？”
眼看无法抵赖，旱魃只得吞吞吐吐地道：“这是因为、因为……有规矩定给我们……”
“谁定的规矩，定了什么规矩，还要我们特意问？你是个拨浪鼓么，打一下出一声？”晏欢含笑道，听见他的声音，旱魃已是遍体生寒，不由得瑟瑟发抖。
“……是旱神，是旱神定下的规矩！”旱魃痛苦地呐喊道，“我们俱是旱神血脉，祂为我们定下规矩，三月之中，仅许狩猎一次！”
“旱神是万物的主宰，”它鼓起勇气，“祂居住在赤水的神宫，天时变化、季节更迭，全在祂的掌握之中。”
晏欢冷笑道：“毫无感觉，所谓旱神，不过自吹自擂自封。先代的赤水女魃倒是货真价实的黄帝之子，只是也早已夭亡，难道随便一只成了气候的魃，堆砌个名为赤水的坟包，就敢自称为神了么？”

他又问：“赤水神宫在哪，守卫情况如何，这个所谓的旱神，具体又有什么神通了？”
旱魃便为他们指明了路线，道：“赤水神宫并无守卫，因为旱神居住在流火千里的原野，即便是我们，在靠近时也会有融化的感觉，因此那里唯有旱神独居。至于神通，我只知道，旱神有一面宝镜，祂会用它来看着世间的场景……”
说到这里，它想到此时此刻的场景，说不定也被旱神看在眼里，惧怕的哆嗦便止也止不住。
旱魃口齿挪动，无比艰难地回答：“……我不晓得法宝来路，只知那镜子名为观世镜。”
该说的都说完了，它焦躁起来，哀哀恳求道：“我……我能说的都说了，你们会遵守诺言，饶我一命，对不对？我知道错了，再也不敢了……”
content_en:
Not only Liu Fuguang and Yan Huan were surprised, the visitor also let out a "bluff" sound from his throat, as if he was surprised that the other party could withstand his blow.
Through the brilliance of the pearl, Liu Fuguang could clearly see that Hanbao's figure was extremely slender, with skin and muscles as black as steel, all clinging to the indestructible bones, giving off a strange bronze sheen, like a ghost in the night. As for the appearance and robes, there was nothing at all. On the rugged skull, there were only two charcoal-like scarlet eyes, which were constantly flashing.
Yan Huan was instantly furious. His cassocks and black hair were flying in the wind, and he was still standing in place. His head and neck suddenly stretched out like a long snake, shaking out in mid-air as fast as lightning, and suddenly wrapped around behind Han Ba. His face and lips turned into the appearance of a dragon with a camel nose and fangs.
He just opened his mouth wide, revealing layers of staggered and rotating sharp teeth, and then bitten half of Hanba's chest ferociously. The dragon's teeth collided with the gold-like copper skin of Drought Demon. In the darkness, scorching sparks erupted in all directions. Drought Demon suddenly felt pain and could not help but let out a roar like a lion's roar.
One bite actually didn't penetrate it, which shows how strong Han Ba's physique is. On Yan Huan's long neck, the tentacles acting as the dragon's mane immediately extended and swarmed in, floating above the seven orifices of the Han Demon. Not only did it pierce the ear canal and nasal cavity, but there were also two sharp thorns that changed like a bird's beak breaking its shell, directly piercing the two fire eyes and licking the brain of the drought demon.
Han Bao inflicted this torture and instantly lost the ability to resist, and his shrill wails echoed in the empty and dark underground.
Black blood flowed thickly down its twisted face, and it shouted hoarsely: "Don't kill me! I'll give you whatever you want!"
Yan Huan opened his mouth and held it still, his neck moved and changed, and another long and narrow mouth full of sharp teeth appeared. He opened and closed it with a sneer and said: "In that case, what will you answer when we ask you?"
For the first time in his life, Han Ba felt a shiver of chill in his heart. After hunting mortals for hundreds of years, has it ever seen such a terrifying thing that transcends common sense? At this moment, life and death were in the hands of the other party. It could only endure the severe pain and said loudly without hesitation: "Yes, yes! Your Majesty, may I ask!"
Liu Fuguang knew in his heart that Han Ba was the first to come towards him. Living in the arid desert, it moved like a fish in water. Therefore, even Yan Huan - or in other words, even Yan Huan whose divine power was greatly weakened, could not detect it in time.
As he thought this, Yan Huan already promised happily: "If what you said is true, I will spare your life. Let me ask you, are you a born Hanban?"
Seeing a ray of dawn, Drought Demon poured beans out of his bamboo tube and said, "I don't know what it means to be born Drought Demon! But from the moment I regained my consciousness, I wandered the boundless land, hunting human beings in order to satisfy my hunger."
The Drought Demon hesitated for a moment, caught its hesitation, whipped its tentacles fiercely, and thrust it into its brain, causing the Drought Demon to scream sharply and shed tears of blood.
After being relieved, Hanba was dying and begged: "Your Majesty's Mingjian, it's far more... it's far more than just me..."
"That's right," Liu Fuguang said, "Since you are not the only one, the living conditions of mortals are so dangerous. Even if they can reproduce and thrive, they are no match for the strength of the drought demons, copper skin and iron bones. They should have been eaten up by you long ago. What's the explanation for this?"
Seeing that he couldn't deny it, Han Ba could only hesitate and said: "This is because, because... there are rules for us..."
"Who made the rules? What rules did we make? Are you a rattle that makes a sound?" Yan Huan said with a smile. Hearing his voice, Hanba felt chills all over his body and couldn't help but shiver.
"...It's the God of Drought, and it's the rules set by the God of Drought!" Drought Demon cried out in pain, "We are all of the blood of the God of Drought, and He has set rules for us. We are only allowed to hunt once in three months!"
"The god of drought is the master of all things," it took courage. "He lives in the palace of Chishui.Change, the changing of seasons, is all in His control. "
Yan Huan sneered and said: "I have no feeling at all. The so-called Drought God is just bragging about himself. The Chishui female demons of the previous generation were the true sons of the Yellow Emperor, but they had died long ago. Could it be that just one of the demonic demons who had become a climate demon and built a tomb named Chishui dared to claim to be a god? "
He asked again: "Where is the Chishui Shrine, how is the guarding situation, and what specific magical powers does this so-called Drought God have? "
Han Ba pointed out the route for them and said: "There are no guards in the Chishui Shrine, because the God of Drought lives in the wilderness of thousands of miles of fire. Even we will feel melted when we get close, so only the God of Drought lives there alone. As for supernatural powers, I only know that the God of Drought has a precious mirror, and he will use it to look at the scenes in the world..."
Having said this, it thought that the scene at this moment might be seen by the God of Drought, and it couldn't stop trembling in fear.
Hanbao moved his mouth and replied with great difficulty: "...I don't know the origin of the magic weapon, I only know that the mirror is called the World-Viewing Mirror. "
After all that had to be said, it became anxious and begged pitifully: "I...I have said all that I can say. You will keep your promise and spare my life, right?" I know I was wrong and I won’t dare to do it again…”
